title: Situational Awareness keeps Anthropic stake in portfolio sale to Citadel
excerpt: Ken Griffin's fund bought a majority of Leopold Aschenbrenner's public equities book, but none of the firm's private holdings.
content_html:
Situational Awareness was forced to sell most of its stocks to Citadel. The fund got to keep its best asset.

By Bradley Saacks

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Even in a meltdown, Leopold Aschenbrenner was able to retain his best asset.

The 25-year-old founder of artificial-intelligence-focused investor Situational Awareness was forced to sell a majority of his public equity holdings to Ken Griffin's $71 billion hedge fund Citadel on Wednesday, several people familiar with the situation confirmed to Business Insider. Outlets, including the Financial Times, Wall Street Journal, and CNBC, had previously reported on the once-$20 billion fund's rapid unwind.

The people confirmed that Situational Awareness did not sell its private portfolio of AI companies, which includes a significant stake in Anthropic, which is expected to go public in the next few months and was last valued at $965 billion in a Series H funding round in May. Aschenbrenner's fiancée also works for the leading AI company.

There were other bidders for the firm's public equities book, which included large positions in AI hardware stocks such as Nebius and Sandisk. Citadel rival Millennium and Situational Awareness investor Jane Street both put in their own offers, people familiar with the situation said.

The firms mentioned declined to comment.

Aschenbrenner was forced to sell to Griffin due to margin calls on positions that the firm had levered up — or borrowed money from banks to juice returns — that had fallen. When positions fall, bank partners ask for additional collateral to protect their investments, news of which can lead to stocks falling further, creating a self-perpetuating downward spiral.

While the high-flying fund, which had returned more than 400% in the year before July, has been humbled, a person close to the fund said the manager will still trade public equities and has kept a small chunk of its book.

Now, though, the fund that was once closely watched by retail traders trying to make a fortune by copying trades will be mostly in private companies, including the gem of its portfolio, Anthropic.

Aschenbrenner, who graduated as the valedictorian from Columbia University at 19, burst on the AI scene when he published a manifesto on the future of AI in the summer of 2024 after he was fired from OpenAI, where he was a researcher. The essay, titled Situational Awareness, predicted the imminent arrival of superintelligence and a potential war with China if the US didn't lead the way.

He decided to start an asset manager focused on the sector, despite having no professional investment experience, launching with less than $1 billion. The fund quickly scaled, counting Silicon Valley bigwigs like Stripe cofounders Patrick and John Collison, former Y Combinator partner Daniel Gross, and onetime GitHub CEO Nat Friedman as original backers.

Correction: July 30, 2026 — An earlier version of this story misstated when Aschenbrenner was fired from OpenAI. It was before he wrote the essay, not after.

Situational Awareness 被迫将大部分股票出售给 Citadel。 该基金必须保留其最好的资产。

作者：Bradley Saacks 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

即使在崩溃的时候，利奥波德·阿申布伦纳仍然能够保留他最好的资产。

几位知情人士向 Business Insider 证实，这位专注于人工智能的投资者 Situational Awareness 的 25 岁创始人周三被迫将其持有的大部分公开股票出售给 Ken Griffin 旗下价值 710 亿美元的对冲基金 Citadel。 包括《金融时报》、《华尔街日报》和 CNBC 在内的媒体此前曾报道过这只规模一度达 200 亿美元的基金迅速撤资的情况。

知情人士证实，Situational Awareness 并未出售其私人人工智能公司投资组合，其中包括 Anthropic 的大量股份，该公司预计将在未来几个月内上市，并在 5 月份的 H 轮融资中最后估值为 9650 亿美元。 阿申布伦纳的未婚妻也在领先的人工智能公司工作。

该公司的公开股票账簿还有其他竞标者，其中包括 Nebius 和 Sandisk 等人工智能硬件股票的大量头寸。 知情人士称，Citadel 的竞争对手 Millennium 和 Situational Awareness 投资者 Jane Street 都提出了自己的报价。

上述公司拒绝置评。

阿申布伦纳被迫将其出售给格里芬，因为该公司提高杠杆的头寸（或从银行借钱以提高回报率）的保证金要求下降了。 当头寸下跌时，银行合作伙伴会要求额外的抵押品来保护他们的投资，而相关消息可能会导致股市进一步下跌，从而形成自我持续的螺旋式下降。

虽然这只在 7 月份之前的一年中回报率超过 400% 的雄心勃勃的基金已经陷入了低谷，但一位接近该基金的人士表示，该基金经理仍将交易公共股票，并保留了一小部分账面资产。

不过，现在，曾经受到散户密切关注、试图通过复制交易发大财的基金将主要投资于私人公司，包括其投资组合中的瑰宝 Anthropic。

阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 19 岁时以哥伦比亚大学毕业生致辞的形式毕业，在被 OpenAI 解雇后，他在 2024 年夏天发表了一份关于人工智能未来的宣言，从而在人工智能界崭露头角。当时他是 OpenAI 的一名研究员。 这篇题为《态势感知》的文章预测，如果美国不带头，超级智能即将到来，并且可能与中国爆发战争。

尽管没有专业投资经验，他还是决定创办一家专注于该行业的资产管理公司，启动资金不到 10 亿美元。 该基金迅速扩大规模，最初的支持者包括 Stripe 联合创始人 Patrick 和 John Collison、前 Y Combinator 合伙人 Daniel Gross 以及 GitHub 前首席执行官 Nat Friedman 等硅谷大佬。

更正：2026 年 7 月 30 日——这个故事的早期版本在 Aschenbrenner 被 OpenAI 解雇时有误述。 这是在他写这篇文章之前，而不是之后。
